research.recommended_topic: Free AI Workflow for College Placements & Job Interviews (ATS Resume, Mock HR Round, Cold Email)
research.audience_problem: Indian college students and freshers are entering campus placement and hiring season, struggling with ATS rejections, lack of interview practice, and generic applications without budget for paid AI tools.
research.why_now: Late August marks the peak start of campus placement drives and off-campus fresher recruitment cycles in Indian universities. Students are actively searching for high-utility, free productivity hacks.
research.hook: Campus placements ya job hunt shuru ho gaya hai? Stop sending generic resumes — use this 10-minute Free AI placement workflow.
supporting_points: Step 1: Use DeepSeek or ChatGPT to extract top ATS keywords from Indian job descriptions and adapt your bullet points.
Step 2: Voice Mode mock interviews — prompt AI to act as a strict Indian tech/business HR manager asking situational & behavioral questions.
Step 3: Draft personalized LinkedIn outreach messages to Indian tech recruiters without sounding like a robotic bot.
Kaam ki baat: Don't fake skills using AI; use it to articulate your genuine college projects clearly.
trend_signals: August-September campus placement drive kickoff across Indian engineering and management colleges
High engagement on Indian Instagram carousels around career hacks, resume optimization, and free student tech tools
Rising popularity of DeepSeek and ChatGPT Voice mode among Tier 1-3 Indian college students

carousel_outline: Slide 1: 'Salary aate hi gayab?' 4 realistic money rules for young Indians (without giving up your daily chai). Swipe ->
Slide 2: Rule 1: The 50-30-20 Rule (Desi Edit) - 50% Needs (Rent, Ration), 30% Wants (Swiggy, Outings), 20% Direct Savings on Day 1.
Slide 3: Rule 2: The 48-Hour Cart Test - Before checking out that late-night impulse buy on Blinkit or Myntra, wait 48 hours.
Slide 4: Rule 3: Automate SIPs for Salary Day + 1 - Treat investing like a mandatory electricity bill, not leftover pocket change.
Slide 5: Rule 4: Separate 'Party Fund' Account - Keep one zero-balance UPI account strictly for weekend fun so you never overspend.
Slide 6: Quick Summary & Action Plan: Save first, spend guilt-free later. Save this post before your next salary credit!
creation.caption:
Salary aayi nahi ki notification sound: 'Amount debited' 🥲

Relatable? Most of us struggle with savings not because we spend too much, but because we save whatever is left over at the end of the month (which is usually ₹0).

Real talk: Smart budgeting doesn't mean skipping weekend chill scenes or sacrificing your favorite cold coffee.

It's about having a simple system so your money works for you on autopilot.

Swipe through the carousel for 4 no-stress money rules you can set up in under 10 minutes 🚀
